description: Per-project OneDrive delivery target, resolved once via a real Microsoft Graph lookup (never guessed). Maps ProjectKey -> the drive_id/item_id of that project's delivery subfolder under 'Claude - Test cases'. Add a row by performing the same real lookup for a new project.

SAMP.resolved_via: Microsoft Graph: GET /drives/{id}/root:/Documents/Claude - Test cases, then /children -> SAMP subfolder

CRM.resolved_via: Microsoft Graph: GET /drives/{id}/root:/Documents/Claude - Test cases, then /children -> CRM subfolder
